answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the ember of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A nebula of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ledge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
